caption: The drawing depicts a single, knee-length dress with short sleeves. The dress is shown flat and upright against a pale, cream-colored background. The dress features vertical red and white stripes throughout the bodice and skirt. The short sleeves, neckline, and hem of the skirt are decorated with yellow or gold bands. The skirt is gathered at the waist, creating a full, slightly flared effect. The overall composition centers the dress with no other objects or decorative elements in the drawing.
title: Child's Dress
